Unit 1 retrieval and practice priorities

Unit 1 · Week 15 · Lesson 1 · Suggested 55-minute plan; adjust to local timing.

Prepare: Open the consolidation chapter and its learning resources. Use paper or a local editor as appropriate, with fictional data and disposable practice copies. The suggested 55-minute lesson is flexible.

Suggested answers are teacher guidance, not extra assessment tasks. These notes are public.

1. Unit 1 retrieval and practice priorities

Suggested time: 2 minutes

Instructional strategy: Learning intention

Explain the goal and the expected independent outcome. Identify a specific skill to practise using evidence. This is ungraded textbook learning. Suggested times can be adjusted to the class. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

2. Retrieval and explanation

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Individual retrieval, then partner comparison

Use brief mixed prompts. Ask for reasoning before showing answers. The purpose is to choose practice, not rank students. Allow silent thinking before discussion. Ask a learner to justify an answer before revealing the explanation. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

3. Consolidation stations

Suggested time: 6 minutes

Instructional strategy: Worked table and teacher explanation

Use the existing consolidation chapter. Choose stations from actual errors rather than attempting every activity superficially. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

4. A useful priority

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Predict, model and explain

Model a small, observable learning need. An explanation with a correct changed example provides better evidence than a broad self-label. Pause for predictions before discussing the expected result. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

5. A short mixed check

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Guided paired practice

Use [8,3,6] index 1 equals 3, and total >= 50 includes 50. Ask students to explain why, then change the values. Swap explaining and checking roles so both learners articulate the reasoning. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

6. Independent practice

Suggested time: 12 minutes

Instructional strategy: Independent application with optional support

Support students to separate knowledge gaps, tracing errors and unclear explanations. Keep goals small enough for the remaining lessons. Offer the relevant worked example if needed, then use a changed case to check independent understanding. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

7. A choice to explain

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Whole-class response and justification

B. Targeted practice responds to the evidence while mixed retrieval still checks other areas. Give thinking time and collect reasons, without recording scores. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

8. Exit explanation

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Individual reflection and fresh explanation

A useful plan connects the particular error, the practice task and an observable corrected result. Use the response to select the next explanation or practice activity. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.
